say:1:1422666001:1.text: First and foremost, Misarte's anger stems from the defiance of her sacred will.
say:1:1422666001:1.source_cn: 首先，关于弥萨忒的怒火来由，是在于违逆神意。

say:2:1422666002:1.text: During the Divine War, it was Misarte's will to stay apart from the conflicts of the world, choosing instead the peace found in the shelter of forests and mountains.
say:2:1422666002:1.source_cn: 对于神魔战争，弥萨忒的意志是远离纷争与战火——在丛林与...

say:3:1422666003:1.text: However, the Sages of that era disregarded this sacred request, choosing instead to offer the power of the Sylvan Egg to Dura and the humans when faced with the war.
say:3:1422666003:1.source_cn: 但当年的贤者们无视了这份嘱托，在面对参战的艾雅与人类一...

say:4:1422666004:1.text: And nearly the entire forest was drawn into the war, and this was the primary cause for Misarte's fury.
say:4:1422666004:1.source_cn: 几乎将整片丛林卷入战火之中——这才是弥萨忒愤怒的主因。

say:6:1422666005:1.text: In other words, the corruption of the Sylvan Egg and the ensuing conflict weren't the main reasons. They merely served to fuel the fire.
say:6:1422666005:1.source_cn: 也就是说，翡绿之卵的被污染与后续的冲突，并不是起因，而...

say:7:1422666006:1.text: Yes, that's why Misarte's punishment was so severe.
say:7:1422666006:1.source_cn: 是的，所以弥萨忒的惩戒才会那样严苛。

say:8:1422666007:1.text: Just as she had severed the corrupted parts away from the Sylvan Egg, she too severed your people from the Wilders.
say:8:1422666007:1.source_cn: 祂将那些人剥离了，正如将翡绿之卵被污染的部分剥离了一样。

say:10:1422666008:0.text: Do you mean that the curse was used to banish us from the Dark Forest?
say:10:1422666008:0.source_cn: 剥离……那是指用诅咒将我们从薄暮丛林驱逐吗？

say:11:1422666009:0.text: Yes, it was used to sever our ties.
say:11:1422666009:0.source_cn: 嗯，事实上，那是剥离的一部分。

say:12:1422666010:1.text: Through Misarte's blessing, her people are woven into the very fabric of nature, their blood intertwined with the rivers and forests.
say:12:1422666010:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒的子民因祂的祝福，而天然同河川与森林有着血脉相连...

say:13:1422666011:1.text: Misarte caused all the rivers and forests within her domain to turn away from the cursed Wilders.
say:13:1422666011:1.source_cn: 弥萨忒的剥离，让所有祂掌管的河川与森林都在排斥着被诅咒...

say:14:1422666012:1.text: So the ground beneath their feet became a bed of knives, and the waters they drank scorched like magma.
say:14:1422666012:1.source_cn: 因此踏在地上，犹如踏在刀锋之上。饮下清水，犹如饮下岩浆。

say:16:1422666013:1.text: They were cast out from Misarte's domain, no longer welcomed among her children.
say:16:1422666013:1.source_cn: 在弥萨忒的领域，不再容忍他们涉足——就是这样的意思。

say:18:1422666014:1.text: Then why were the Essail able to settle in Sal'thorin?
say:18:1422666014:1.source_cn: 唔，那这样的话，为什么艾塞勒到了萨洛克兰就能暂时安定下来呢？

choice_prompt:19:1422666014.text: Then why were the Essail able to settle in Sal'thorin?
choice_prompt:19:1422666014.source_cn: 唔，那这样的话，为什么艾塞勒到了萨洛克兰就能暂时安定下来呢？

say:20:1422666015:1.text: Yes, the world underground does not belong to Misarte.
say:20:1422666015:1.source_cn: 是哦，地底区域并不属于弥萨忒。

say:21:1422666017:1.text: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.
say:21:1422666017:1.source_cn: 那主人用织叶解除诅咒，就像是借用拥有弥萨忒之力翡绿之卵...
say:21:1422666017:1.male: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.
say:21:1422666017:1.female: Well, the Magister used the Sylvan Tendril to lift the curse, just as one would use the Sylvan Egg to lift the punishment.

say:22:1422666018:1.text: The Sylvan Egg surely holds the power to lift the curse, but doing so would mean bypassing Misarte's authority and using magic directly to break it.
say:22:1422666018:1.source_cn: 但是，这只是主人作为梅林的代行，弥萨忒本人并没有解除惩罚。

say:23:1422666019:1.text: So when Indris entered Misarte's realm, the Mysalind and the butterflies blocked his path, and the Deer Spirit grew angry. Is this why? Because we sidestepped her authority?
say:23:1422666019:1.source_cn: 所以在因度厄出现在弥萨忒的领域时，迈萨林德和蝴蝶会阻拦...

choice_prompt:24:1422666019.text: So when Indris entered Misarte's realm, the Mysalind and the butterflies blocked his path, and the Deer Spirit grew angry. Is this why? Because we sidestepped her authority?
choice_prompt:24:1422666019.source_cn: 所以在因度厄出现在弥萨忒的领域时，迈萨林德和蝴蝶会阻拦，鹿灵会愤怒，是因为这个吗？

say:26:1422666020:1.text: There are still things we can't fully explain, but at least some of the concerns have been put to rest.
say:26:1422666020:1.source_cn: 还是有一些无法解释的事，但至少能覆盖一部分疑惑了。

say:27:1422666022:1.text: I see. After hearing all that, I can see why Misarte is so angry.
say:27:1422666022:1.source_cn: 在你们的解释后，我大概能理解弥萨忒的愤怒。

say:28:1422666023:1.text: But with the war spreading, as a major power in these lands, could we really have just stood aside?
say:28:1422666023:1.source_cn: 但面对蔓延的战火，作为大陆的一员，是否真的能独善其身？

say:29:1422666024:1.text: What followed was a great Divine War that swept across Esperia...
say:29:1422666024:1.source_cn: 后续可是席卷伊索米亚大陆的神魔战争啊……

say:30:1422666025:1.text: Although I don't agree with some of the decisions made by Sage Tasso and Seralyth in the past, during that war, when the world was at risk, could we afford to do nothing?
say:30:1422666025:1.source_cn: 尽管我不认同塔萨贤者和奈萨雷斯之前的一些决策，但在那场...

say:31:1422666026:1.text: Therefore, I don't believe my ancestors were wrong in choosing to go to war.
say:31:1422666026:1.source_cn: 所以，我并不认为我的先祖在选择参战上犯了错。

say:32:1422666027:1.text: As for the corruption of the Sylvan Egg, it was indeed their fault... No, our fault.
say:32:1422666027:1.source_cn: 至于翡绿之卵被污染之事，确实是他们……不，我们的过错。

say:33:1422666028:1.text: But we've paid the price for two thousand years. Surely, that's more than enough punishment, isn't it?
say:33:1422666028:1.source_cn: 但我们也为此付出了两千年的代价。这样的惩罚，难道还不够吗？

say:35:1422666029:1.text: Indris, the gods see the world differently from mortals. To Misarte, this isn't simply punishment. It was also necessary to safeguard her people.
say:35:1422666029:1.source_cn: 因度厄，神明的思维与凡人不同。对弥萨忒而言，这不仅是惩...

say:36:1422666030:1.text: Since you believe your ancestors made the right choice, then show the resolve needed to face <style="highlight">Misarte's trial</style>.
say:36:1422666030:1.source_cn: 既然你认为先祖的选择无错，那就拿出相应的决心来接受<s...

say:37:1422666031:1.text: If you seek Misarte's forgiveness, you must find the strength within yourself to renew your bond with the earth and the mountains.
say:37:1422666031:1.source_cn: 如果你想得到弥萨忒的宽恕，就必须凭借自己的力量，与大地...

say:38:1422666032:1.text: Only by proving your understanding of Misarte's will can you receive her guidance and find the path to resolve the plight of your people.
say:38:1422666032:1.source_cn: 只有证明你们已经理解了弥萨忒的意志，才能让祂降下新的指...

say:40:1422666034:1.text: Very well, Misarte's messengers will guide your path.
say:40:1422666034:1.source_cn: 别担心，弥萨忒的使者将会指引你的道路。

say:43:1422666021:1.text: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.
say:43:1422666021:1.source_cn: 毕竟弥萨忒本人没有答应，但梅林凭借力量解决了，确实算是作弊。
say:43:1422666021:1.male: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.
say:43:1422666021:1.female: Though Misarte did not give her consent for you to lift the curse, you still ended up doing it with your raw magic. Rather than cheating, I'd call that bending the rules.

choice:24:1:2.text: Did I cheat with my power?
choice:24:1:2.male: Did I cheat with my power?
choice:24:1:2.female: Did I cheat with my power?

say:44:1422666016:1.text: That's right. It's under Helthor's domain, not Misarte's.
say:44:1422666016:1.source_cn: 对哦，那里毕竟是赫托的领域所在，也不是弥萨忒的地域。

choice:19:1:2.text: Could be due to Helthor's power.
choice:19:1:2.male: Could be due to Helthor's power.
choice:19:1:2.female: Could be due to Helthor's power.
